row_definition: One row = one FHIR ExplanationOfBenefit claim within one pipeline run.
One row = one EOB item within one claim and pipeline run.
One row = one claim-level EOB total element at its exact source ordinal.
One row = one claim-level adjudication element at its exact source ordinal.
One row = one adjudication element for one EOB item at its exact source ordinal.
One row = one diagnosis occurrence attached to one claim.
One row = one procedure occurrence attached to one claim.
One row = one care-team participation occurrence attached to one claim.
One row = one supporting-information occurrence attached to one claim.
One row = one EOB item detail element within one claim item.
